comment: Dr. Cable is a really nice Professor. Music Scenes is a pretty cool class because it exposed me to a lot of new and fun concerts I would have never been to. She's old school and doesn't use Blackboard, so don't lose your paper syllabus. She also gives closed note quizzes after every reading which are kinda hard. Otherwise a good gen ed choice

Her music scenes class is alright but a good choice to knock out a gen ed. The readings are sometimes long and the quizzes are weirdly hard. Its also annoying cause you have to go to like 6 on campus concerts throughout the semester. The final project is super easy. Overall though shes a nice teacher and it isn't too difficult to do well.
